subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should this stack retain the production Gateway admission change in the QA migration, or should that lifecycle change be split before the Matrix scenario migration lands?
rationale: The branch is well-proven and has no concrete correctness finding, but the Gateway change crosses from private QA infrastructure into production channel-restart lifecycle semantics, which requires owner intent rather than automated judgment.

options.title: Split Gateway lifecycle change
options.body: Move the admission helper, reload-handler edits, and focused tests into a separate owner-reviewed PR while keeping this branch centered on Matrix QA migration and dependency ownership.

options.title: Approve the combined stack
options.body: Keep the Gateway change here only after an appropriate owner confirms its lifecycle semantics and a repository admin or security reviewer authorizes the exact dependency graph.

recommendation.title: Split Gateway lifecycle change
recommendation.body: Move the admission helper, reload-handler edits, and focused tests into a separate owner-reviewed PR while keeping this branch centered on Matrix QA migration and dependency ownership.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current migration stack and the merged prerequisite, so they are the best available coordinator for splitting or securing the additional owner approvals.
